hero.lead: Grab All2K, plug in, and let the sidewalk soundtrack roll. One tap to download, under a minute to install.
hero.hintMobile: Swipe up to flip · sideways to spin
why.heading: Why All2K?
why.c1.title: Feels different
why.c1.body: From the first second, listening feels less like using an app and more like a moment you want to stay in.
why.c2.title: Made with care
why.c2.body: Every detail is shaped so your music always takes center stage. No noise, just the good stuff.
why.c3.title: Keeps growing
why.c3.body: New versions land right inside the app. Install it once and it grows with you.
specs.heading: The specs
install.heading: Get it in 3 moves
install.s1.title: Download
install.s1.body: Hit the big button. You get an .apk file.
install.s2.title: Install
install.s2.body: Open the file. If Android asks, allow installs from your browser.
install.s3.title: Press play
install.s3.body: Launch All2K and go. That’s the whole trick.
faq.heading: Quick answers
faq.a1: Every release is signed by the developer, and Android only accepts updates signed with the same key.
faq.a2: Open the app and check for updates. Done.
faq.a3: A regular Android app file. Open it, tap install, and it works like any other app.
final.heading: Ready to roll?
dl.androidSub: Follow these three steps on your Android device:
dl.step1: Open the downloaded .apk file from your notifications or Downloads.
dl.step2: Allow installs from your browser if Android asks.
dl.otherSub: Scan this QR code with your Android phone or send the link over.
